newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Rosenbauer 96 earnings up, sees more for 97.
newsitem.headline: Rosenbauer 96 earnings up, sees more for 97.

text.p: Rosenbauer International AG, an Austrian manufacturer of fire engines, reported on Wednesday higher group earnings in 1996 and said it expected to post double-digit growth in the current year.

Rosenbauer said pretax profit rose 21.2 percent to 79.4 million schillings while sales climbed 4.6 percent to 2.03 billion schillings. Net profit was a shade higher at 47.2 million, up from 46.5 million in 1995.
The company said in a statement it plans to raise its dividend to 16 schillings from 15. For the current year, Rosenbauer sees sales climbing 10 percent and pretax profit jumping 20 percent.
